issues.quote: Most of them can't. Honey is a tough little fortress.
issues.problem: Beo asks if germs can't come in, and Huy agrees. That is misleading. The source says most microorganisms cannot grow in honey because it has so much sugar and so little water. It does not say they cannot get in. Honey stays safe because it is sealed or kept in a closed jar, and because germs cannot grow in it.
issues.fix: Some germs may get in, but most of them can't grow in it. Honey is a tough little fortress.
